title: Metallbau cuts the allocation for Coupling guard, galvanised
briefing: You negotiate for Hollerau Pumpenwerke with Metallbau Steinfelder KG. Metallbau cuts the allocation for Coupling guard, galvanised. Need: 12700 pc a year. Category goal: secure supply of a bottleneck part: coverage of the full need and a supplier that stays healthy come first. Score: the lowest total cost C as defined in the rules, valued with this case's rates (need lead time 25 days). There is no fallback supplier: without a deal the demand is bought at the fallback price. Must-haves: lead_time_days <= 34. Prepare from the data package.
